narrative:
Hancock County has 49,809 registered voters, with 14.9% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 38.8% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 42.5%, a modest Democratic lean of 3.7 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 28.0% of registrants.
